name: rolecasting
description: Rolecasting: portable model selection and delegation topology for agent work.

interface.shortDescription: Choose agent roles, models, and delegation topology.
interface.longDescription: Rolecasting keeps consequential decisions with the leader, delegates bounded work, and reauthorizes an eligible model route before every payload-bearing transition.
defaultPrompt: Use $rolecasting:delegating-cross-agent-work to freeze topology and enforce the transition gate for this bounded dispatch.
Use $rolecasting:choosing-agent-models to authorize the model transition before this task payload is dispatched.
